articleTitle: Fall detection algorithm for the elderly based on human posture estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the acceleration of the global aging process, the safety and health of the elderly has become a widespread concern, and falls have become the main health threat of the elderly. In this paper, a fall detection model based on OpenPose human posture estimation algorithm is proposed by using the fall detection method based on machine vision. On the basis of OpenPose human key point detection, combined with SSD MobileNet object detection framework can remove the non human key points detected by OpenPose algorithm, reduce the false detection rate of the algorithm, improve the robustness of the algorithm in complex environment, and then extract the features of human joint points, use SVDD classification algorithm to classify, experiments show that this method can effectively detect the occurrence of falls, and the accuracy rate can reach more than 93%.

articleTitle: SAR ATR Using Complex-Valued CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the past years, many classification algorithms have proven to be effective and efficient in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Automatic Target Recognition (ATR). Among them, classification algorithms based on convolutional neural network (CNN) have attracted extensive interest because of high accuracy. However, many CNN-based SAR ATR algorithms just use the amplitude information of SAR data, ignoring the phase information. In this study, a complex-valued CNN is proposed to address this issue. We introduce the complex-valued operations in the calculation of the network, so the complex-valued CNN can extract features in the complex-valued field. It is beneficial to utilize both the amplitude and phase information of the SAR data. And our complex-valued CNN utilizes the Squeeze and Excitation Module (SE Module) to apply weighting factors for the feature maps in the same layer. In ten military targets of MSTAR classification experiment, our model achieves a recognition rate of 98.97%. The accuracy of our complex-valued CNN is superior to many real-valued CNN algorithms in the MSTAR classification experiment.

articleTitle: Evolution of Facial Tissue Oxygen Saturation and Detection of Human Physical Stress
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Physical stress has a direct impact on human health, which makes the detection of physical stress necessary in daily life. In this paper, we extracted tissue oxygen saturation (StO2) by hyperspectral imaging to detect and distinguish physical stress from relaxation state remotely. During the physical stress experiment, we observed that the facial StO2 right after the stress can be either increased and decreased comparing to the baseline, the StO2 after two minutes recovered towards the baseline. This changes of StO2 is reported for the first time. Based on the findings, we also located some useful ROIs on face for the detection of human physical stress.

articleTitle: A Lane Recognition Based on Line-CNN Network
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Lane detection and has always been a very challenging problem because traffic lines contain different categories are often blocked and worn by vehicles. In recent years, many sophisticated lane detection methods have been proposed. However, most methods focus on detecting the location of lans and ignore the importance of classification. This paper studies the network Line-CNN: End-to-End Traffic Line Detection With Line Proposal Unit (Line-CNN) and Towards End-to-End Lane Detection an Instance Segmentation Approach (LaneNet), proposes a lane recognition method based on Line-CNN network adding lane classification task. Compared with previous work, we can not only predict any number of lanes without post-processing, but also recognize between different categories of traffic lines. Experiment on two public datasets verify our method and achieve competitive results.

articleTitle: An Acceleration Algorithm of 3D Point Cloud Registration Based on Iterative Closet Point
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: We propose a novel method for 3D point cloud registration. By considering first order approximation to the data point, our algorithm finds more accurate point pairs than using the closet point strategy. Moreover, we use a new distance error measurement in the ICP framework which considers the second order geometry information rather the first order geometry information in the popular point-plane distance error. Experimental results show that the proposed scheme not only speeds up the convergence of registration, but also eliminates wrong pairing of data points. Both the efficiency of point cloud data registration and the performance of the algorithm have been significantly improved compared with the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Ocean ship detection and recognition algorithm based on aerial image
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Because the image of UAV aerial photography is easy to be affected by light, sea area and other conditions, there are many kinds of ships. Under different conditions, the characteristics of ships are different, which makes the target recognition more difficult. In order to improve the efficiency of sea surface supervision and make the sea surface management more intelligent, an ocean ship detection algorithm based on aerial photography image is proposed. In this paper, the improved Yolo algorithm is mainly used for high-efficiency ship detection of aerial video, which can achieve real-time performance and detection speed of 23fps. In order to improve the accuracy, this paper proposes a standardized mechanism of fixed frame length detection results, which uses deep learning mask RCNN algorithm for fine detection of specific frame images, and the detection map is 85%, which improves the detection speed without affecting the detection speed The accuracy of the algorithm forms an efficient and accurate algorithm for the detection of ships on the sea, which brings convenience to the management of the sea.

articleTitle: Text Sentiment Classification Based on Improved BiLSTM-CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Deep learning methods are popular in natural language processing methods. Because different models will extract different features in the text, traditional machine learning models still have room for expansion in optimization. Based on this fact, this paper proposes a sentiment classification algorithm based on improved BiLSTM-CNN. Firstly, the user's words are converted into vectors by the frequency of words in the text, and the sequence features in the text are extracted through BiLSTM. Then further feature extraction is performed on the data through CNN, so that more dimensional user information can be used for classification. The experimental results show that the model constructed according to this method takes into account the relationship between different features in the text, and effectively optimizes traditional algorithms. Compared with related traditional network models, the performance is slightly improved in text sentiment classification.

articleTitle: Investigation and Application of Smart Door Locks based on Bluetooth Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Recent studies show the design of smart door locks is mainly based on CPU card technology. However, this design is costly with poor confidentiality. In this paper, a new method of smart door locks which can be controlled through Bluetooth is proposed. The first process of the method is an overall design of smart door locks based on Bluetooth control, including central controller, door locks controller, Bluetooth communication module and system keyboard. The second process is hardware design of smart door locks, which mainly adopts Bluetooth serial port module, drive motor, limit switch and current detection module of smart door locks system and STC15F2K32S2 single chip microcomputer. The last process is software design. The software consists of the control software of smart door locks and client Bluetooth software for mobile intelligent terminal. Experiments show that this new method of smart door locks based on Bluetooth control is more economical, safer, more flexible, and more efficient.

articleTitle: Analysis of University Students Employment Recommendation System Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: “Employment Recommendation System for College Students Based on Apriori Algorithm”, which has taken the big data of the web recruitment platform in China as its technology and service foundation, has adopted Apriori recommendation algorithm to restructure relevant quality information on employment intelligently by data analyzing information on employment of all large recruitment platforms. The system has achieved the accurate employment recommendation for college students, which has improved not only the job satisfaction and employment rate of college students, but the work efficiency of employment service for college students.

articleTitle: Emotion analysis of microblog based on emotion dictionary and Bi-GRU
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The colloquialism and conciseness of microblog text bring additional challenges to emotion classification. This paper proposes a new emotion classification model based on hybrid learning. In the first stage, the improved dictionary classification method is used to calculate emotion score in the whole data set, and the data with high or low scores are directly marked; in the second stage, the rest of the method is based on emotion dictionary and Bi-GRU fusion model to calculate emotion score, and the two stage hybrid frame makes the method effectively applied in microblog emotion classification. The microblog experiment with emoticons in COAE2014 (Chinese opinion analysis and evaluation 2014) dataset shows that the single model is not ideal for many kinds of complex contexts, and it is difficult and low accuracy. The multi model fusion method can effectively improve the error preference of the single model and improve the classification effect.

articleTitle: Prediction of future citation count with machine learning and neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Prediction of long-term citation counts of paper is increasingly important in academic community. In this work, the prediction of future citation counts is considered as binary classification task. The study is based on 2600 papers of physiology extracted from Web of Science. Eight bibliometric features of citing paper in the first three years after the publication of paper were selected. Three machine learning model and a neural network are built to test whether these features are effective in prediction of future citation counts. The experimental result shows that the selected features are valuable in the prediction of long-term citation counts. And the machine learning and neural network are useful for the task of predicating future citation counts.

articleTitle: Cross-lingual Sentiment Analysis via AAE and BiGRU
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As a significant task in nature language processing (NLP), sentiment analysis has got more and more attention. Sufficient data and helpful tools are available when doing the studying. Therefore, it is meaningful to study techniques to leverage labeled data and models valid in rich datasets language when addressing any questions in rare language. As a result, cross-lingual sentiment analysis has become more and more popular. Compared with traditional translation method, transfer learning is the main trend and using deep learning to generate a cross-lingual word embeddings in the single vector space is more useful and stable. Hence getting the high quality of cross-lingual word embedding is the big problem which needs to be settled urgently. In this paper, we use the LSTM and Adversarial Auto Encoders (AAE) to generate contextual cross-lingual word embeddings for transfer learning, then the BiGRU is used for analyzing the sentiment. Experimental results prove that our method has the best performance.

articleTitle: Position Sensorless Control of Switched Reluctance Motor Based on Simplified Flux Method
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to the unique characteristics of SRM (switched reluctance motors), switched reluctance motors are increasingly being applied to a variety of harsh working environments such as dust, high temperature, and humidity. There is an increasing need for research on position sensorless for switched reluctance motors. This article describes a method for studying the position detection of a switched reluctance motor. By establishing a flux-current meter for a fixed commutation position, it is checked whether the meter reaches the commutation value and commutation control is performed. Using the simulation module in MATLAB, a simulation model of the switched reluctance motor without position sensor is constructed. The feasibility of this method is verified by SIMULINK simulation module. It turns out that the method is suitable for the medium and high speed stage of a switched reluctance motor.

articleTitle: Research on quantitative trading strategy based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the gradual maturity of the domestic financial quantitative trading market, more and more investors have recognized the quantitative investment because of its relatively stable income. Investment trading is not interfered by human beings. Analyzing the historical data of market trading has the characteristics of high probability of winning. This paper will take s300etf(159912) as an example, combine the double moving average and Counter-market operating indicator(CDP), explain the application law of the indicator, and discuss how to better grasp the market and achieve higher return on investment through the two indicators. Stock data is a classical financial time series, so Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM), as a classical model in the cyclic neural network model, can predict the trading index through LSTM. In this paper, the backtrader platform is used to simulate the transaction of historical data, and the benefits of the simulated transaction are discussed.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Data Exchange based on JSON
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: JSON is a lightweight data interchange technology. In order to solve the problems in the process of integrating data of various agricultural application systems, such as heterogeneity, redundancy and low degree of sharing, on Henan Rural Information Integrated Service Platform, a data exchange scheme based on JSON Technology is designed by JAVA programming language in this study, and which achieved data interchange between portal platform and other agricultural application systems. It is proved that this scheme has some advantages, such as fast parsing and low data redundancy, high exchange efficiency, and so on.

articleTitle: Coherence Parameters Estimation Algorithm for Distributed Coherent Aperture Radar in Low SNR Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A method of reducing parameters estimation error by multi-pulse accumulation is proposed to deal with the problem of large error and low coherence performance of distributed coherent aperture radar in low SNR(signal-to-noise ratio) environment. This method uses different coherent accumulation methods for low-speed and high-speed moving targets respectively. For low-speed targets without range migration, discrete Fourier transform is used to achieve multi-pulse coherent accumulation. For high-speed targets, the keystone transform is used to correct the range migration firstly, and then the coherent accumulation is realized by discrete Fourier transform. Then, the peak picking method is used to estimate the coherence parameters. Finally, the coherence parameters estimation process in low SNR environment is given in combination with two cases. The simulation results show that, compared with the method of monopulse signal, this method can obtain higher estimation performance of coherence parameters in low SNR environment. And with the increase of accumulated pulses, the estimation performance of coherence parameters also improves.

articleTitle: A Smartphone-based Sleep Monitoring Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Sleep is a very important physiological activity in life. The quality of sleep directly affects people ’s health. At present, common sleep monitoring products from smart mattresses to smart bracelets, although they can monitor sleep, must either be laid on the bed or must be worn throughout the night, which does not provide a good user experience. At the same time, such products mainly rely on the single factor of physical activity to judge sleep, and many details of the sleep process cannot be discussed in depth, such as breathing and snoring. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a non-contact human sleep monitoring method, which judges sleep staging by two aspects of body motion and respiration and compares it with traditional wristband products to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Discovery of Key Nodes in Social Networks Premised on PageRank Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: By abstracting the complex structure of social network into undirected graph, nodes into pages and edges into hyperlinks, and combining PageRank algorithm with the discovery of key nodes in social networks, this thesis comes up with a new algorithm of key nodes premised on improved PageRank algorithm, and finally employs microblog data as data set. Through the experiment of comparing KeyRank algorithm with TIPR algorithm, it can be concluded that the PageRank algorithm proposed in this thesis is comparatively suitable for discovering key nodes. Under the same data set, the efficiency of identifying key nodes is raised by 30% in comparison with the other two algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Home Assistance Control Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper studies how smart homes provide users with convenient and comfortable services. The data generated by users’ daily lives can accumulate after a certain period of time and can form a huge basic data set. It contains many valuable information, but usually the information values of these data sets cannot be obtained intuitively, and their distribution is sparse. How to use them effectively and mine out effective information to provide users with intelligent life services are always the goals pursued by researchers. In this paper, machine learning technology is applied to smart home, and a smart home assisted control model based on machine learning is proposed. The model’s machine learning unit will fuse the data of the two aspects, and then predict the status of home equipment, and do some home systems. Behavior feedback, which in turn helps the user to do some secondary control of smart home system operation. Experiments have proved that the assistance system designed in this paper has a high accuracy in the intelligent control of equipment.

articleTitle: Construction and Application Evaluation of the Traffic Management Information Verification Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, many applications involving in traffic management information system query vehicles, violations, driving licenses from multiple data sources. There are many redundant codes in the query function and they are coupled with other services, which leads the code to be poor readable and difficult to maintain. In order to solve the above problems, this paper develops and provides a unified data verification service platform. The architecture of platform, among which connection protocol and distributed rate limiter are presented, is constructed and proposed. The most suitable signature algorithm and the best way of implementing distributed lock are adapted by comparison. Comprehensive computational and statistical tests show that the platform can query business data based on different data sources, which is suitable for different levels of security scenarios of the Internet and public security networks, and achieves unified prevention, control, monitoring, and tracking management goals.

articleTitle: Ship Detection of Infrared Image in Complex Scene Based on Bilateral Filter Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the low resolution infrared image data, this paper adopts the method of high and low frequency decomposition based on bilateral filtering to enhance the infrared image. It can effectively retain the ship target details and suppress the large area background noise. Aiming at the low resolution of infrared image, this paper uses small convolution kernel and convolution with holes to optimize SSD network structure and remove the pooling layer. Fully considering its low resolution characteristics, it can effectively improve the detection accuracy of ship targets in complex scenes. The results show that compared with the traditional SVD and SSD methods, the accuracy of this method is improved by 1.8% and 9.8% respectively in complex scenes, which is better than the traditional detection method.

articleTitle: Convenience of Voice Interaction Design in the 5G Era to Adapt to Agricultural Machinery
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, 5G era is coming. Under the guidance of OFDM technology, 5G has a profound impact on all walks of life in the future, providing a flexible, efficient and extensible strong support for the new network, and applying the voice interface design to the operation panel of agricultural machinery. This paper introduces the hidden Markov algorithm as the core, designs the isolated word speech recognition strategy and the noise pretreatment improvement strategy. On this basis, the construction of voice interactive service system technology can play a certain role in improving the operation convenience of agricultural machinery and promoting agricultural production.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Technology based Credit System for Personal Financial information
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Blockchain technology solves the trust and security problems in many industries with its advantages of decentralization and autonomy, and it also satisfies the needs of credit system design. It can be applied to the design of credit system. Meanwhile, personal financial information of citizens also contains great commercial value in the information age. Some unscrupulous businesses or individuals will obtain the personal financial information of citizens through illegal means and trade illegally on the Internet. The construction of credit system can solve these problems. In this article, credit system can apply to personal financial information based on blockchain technology. We expect and suggest that it can also protect the privacy and improve the security of personal financial information.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation Of Domestic News Collection System Based On Python
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the era of rapid development of the Internet, network media has become a new window for people to understand the outside world due to its fast speed and wide spread. News is a channel for people to know about Surrounding Information, but thousands of news are produced every day on the Internet. These news are needed or not in inside. How to efficiently and accurately obtain the news content we need from the website is a great need in people’s life. This system aims to collect news on specific websites and return it to users with concise and clear pages. Users can search specific keywords to select news that they are interested in so as to realize personalization for users. This system crawls and processes the domestic financial news content, which is convenient for people to process the information. In order to avoid duplication of information, the system has also implemented a self-defined deduplication rule. In the specific implementation, the system is written using Python in conjunction with the Scrapy framework and Django framework, which can simplify the system code to a certain extent. The practical value of this system lies in the timely, efficient and convenient access to domestic financial news that people care about, need and are interested in.

articleTitle: Research of Medical Insurance Based on the Combination of Blockchain and Credit Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet, artificial intelligence and big data, blockchain technology and credit technology came into being, and the mode of combining the blockchain and credit happens generally. However, this model is rarely involved in the field of medical insurance. In this article, it researches on the relationship of blockchain and credit technology, and the application of combining blockchain and credit technology in medical insurance in our county based on the retrospective, Tamper Proof, and decentralized characters of blockchain and the service of credit report, credit evaluation and Credit information consultation. It would solve the problems of incomplete and asymmetric information among medical institutions, patients, and medical insurance organizations, and also the problems of dishonesty in medical insurance.

articleTitle: Research on the Cost Control of Cross-border E-commerce Overseas Warehouse from the Perspective of Big Data Technology and Storage Theory Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Big data has become an important direction of development of modern information technology. “PERSONA” is a mathematical modeling of users in the real world, it is a specific application of big data in economic life. User information characterization through different things and statistical indicators, we can correlate them well and match. Based on “PERSONA”, integration with EOQ system, derived sales forecast system and inventory control system, build a perfect dynamic architecture for your business.“ Overseas Warehouse” as a product of the rapid development of cross-border e-commerce logistics has many advantages, but the biggest risk is increasing costs due to difficult inventory control. This research proposes a proposal to combine “big data technology and storage theory model”, forecasting demand through big data modeling. Then it uses the economic order model to calculate the reasonable purchase volume, safety stock and order point. Through the use of the model, it could help companies to achieve scientific and efficient use of overseas warehouse and reduce the cost.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Recommendation Algorithm Combing Naive Bayes Classifier and the Users’ Trust Relationship
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, a huge amount of information is shown to the clients, thus leading to the so-called ‘information explosion’ or ‘information overload’. Recommend technique can follow the demand change of clients and automatically adjust the mode and contents of information service. Based on the problems of collaborative filtering recommendation of internal storage including the overdue calculation amount in large-scale system, difficult realization of real time recommendation, poor system expansibility, lack of novelty purely based on contents or the existing interests of clients, this paper proposes hybrid recommendation technique based on naive Bayesian model and client trust. On one hand, it establishes the hobby model of clients and apply Bayesian classification algorithm according to the interests of clients to recommend the classified products to clients. On the other hand, according to trust relation of clients, recommend products of higher praise to trusted clients and tap the potential interests of clients, which not only can guarantee the accuracy of recommendation, but also is of expansibility.

articleTitle: Simulation electromagnetic gun launching system based on stm32
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The electromagnetic gun uses the ampere force generated by the electromagnetic field in the electromagnetic system to accelerate the shell, thus generating the kinetic energy required by the shell to launch and hit the target. An electromagnetic gun launching system with STM32 as the controller is introduced. Openmv camera combined with laser ranging module can automatically capture the initial angle of the target deviated from the muzzle and input the distance or key according to the muzzle. STM32 controller can calculate the shooting distance and angle according to the returned coordinate value and adjust the muzzle angle through algorithm to attack accurately. Electromagnetic gun is often used in military as a new type of weapon, which has the advantages of fast launching speed, convenient adjustment and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: A Study on Online Detection of micro-blog Rumors Based on Naive Bayes Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The paper puts forward a rumor detection model based on Naive Bayes and NLP according to the data volume of detecting micro-blog rumors. Firstly, the model processes micro-blog text through NLP methods, including Chinese particles, stop words, and word vectors. Next, the processed text is input into the algorithm model of machine learning based on Naive Bayes. Eventually, the model verifies the authenticity of processed micro-blog information. Compared with manual rumor detection, this detection model reduces processing time for nearly 10h. Also, its accuracy of identifying micro-blog rumors increases by 15% than that of micro-blog rumor detection algorithms based on the decision tree, showing it is more applicable to current micro-blog platforms.

articleTitle: Consistency Verification of SiPM and HFCT for detecting partial discharges
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Compared with the traditional partial discharge detection method, the photometric method can avoid the influence caused by electromagnetic interference. Silicon photomultiplier (SiPM) is a new type of photometric sensor. In order to explore the consistency between it and high frequency current transducer (HFCT) on performance in detecting partial discharge, this article draws the phase resolved partial discharge (PRPD) pattern under different defects and compares the two kinds of system operators. Finally, we draw conclusion that SiPM and HFCT have a good consistency in the partial discharge starting voltage and pulse resolution for different discharges and the consistency of two statistical operators is also good. The partial discharge detection capability of SiPM is further verified.

articleTitle: The Research Context, Latest Hotspots And Evolution Trend Of Global Robots–Based On Visual Analysis Of Citespace
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Theoretical research on robots and the development of key technologies is one of the current research hotspots, adopting Citespace as the visualization tool, and with the target literatures of the WOS database as the research object to carry out statistical analysis and content analysis on the research history of robots. The system sorts out the spatial and temporal distribution, knowledge groups, subject structures and hotspot fields, latest researches and evolutionary trends of global robotics research, combined with the nation’s great demands and the latest development of discipline, sets forth the research hotspots and development trends on current robotics, and draws many objective conclusions based on the facts, as well as several challenge problems that need to be solved in hurry in the basic theory and key technologies of the robots are extracted. Points out the current research foundations and deficiencies in this field, and put out direction proposal of the key points in this field for the next 5 to 10 years, which provides theoretical support and practical guidance for the research direction of future robots.

articleTitle: Weakly Supervised Image Semantic Segmentation with Bounding Box Annotation
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Image semantic segmentation can understand and analyze image scenes for low-level computer vision. But it has always faced the challenges of complex feature extraction and difficult data annotation. In view of the time-consuming and expensive of pixel-level labeling, we mainly study a weakly supervised image semantic segmentation model on bounding box annotations. Firstly, the image pixel-level feature extraction is performed through a densely sampled fully convolution network based on pyramids modules, and then the GrubCut algorithm is used to process the weakly supervised data. Finally, the image features and labeled data are jointly trained to build a weakly supervised image semantic segmentation model for bounding box annotations. Experimental results show that the weakly supervised model constructed in this paper achieves better segmentation results than other weakly supervised models.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm Fuses Semantic Nearest Neighbors Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To solve the problem that collaborative filtering only uses the items-users rating matrix, a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm fuses semantic nearest neighbors based on Knowledge Graph is presented. This method fuses semantic nearest neighbors and embeds the existing semantic database into a low-dimensional semantic space. It combines the semantic information of items and collaborative filtering using calculating the semantic similarity between items. The shortcoming of collaborative filtering which does not consider the semantic information of items is overcame, and therefore the effect of collaborative filtering result is improved on the semantic level. Experimental results show that the proposed methods can get higher values on Recall, Accuracy and F-value for collaborative filtering systems.

articleTitle: Research on Information Security Technology of Mobile Application in Electric Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous popularization of smart terminals, Android and IOS systems are the most mainstream mobile operating systems in the market, and their application types and application numbers are constantly increasing. As an open system, the security issues of Android application emerge in endlessly, such as the reverse decompilation of installation package, malicious code injection, application piracy, interface hijacking, SMS hijacking and input monitoring. These security issues will also appear on mobile applications in the power industry, which will not only result in the embezzlement of applied knowledge copyrights but also lead to serious leakage of users' information and even economic losses. It may even result in the remote malicious control of key facilities, which will cause serious social issues. Under the background of the development of smart grid information construction, also with the application and promotion of power services in mobile terminals, information security protection for mobile terminal applications and interactions with the internal system of the power grid has also become an important research direction. While analyzing the risks faced by mobile applications, this article also enumerates and analyzes the necessary measures for risk resolution.

articleTitle: Research On Safety Risk Rating Of Drivers Based On Spectral Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A large number of researches have shown that illegal operations cause most traffic and road safety issues. At present, however, there are fewer studies on the illegal operation itself, it is very necessary to study the mechanism of traffic violation behaviors causing the road safety, as well as grasp the laws and characteristics of traffic violations, in order to take targeted governance and prevention measures to form the scientific and systematic theory. Based on the illegal driving behaviors of drivers and the related data, this paper conducts the cluster analysis on the data samples of their behaviors through the spectral clustering algorithm to obtain the risk rating conclusion. In addition, the paper further deeply explores the illegal behaviors of low-risk, medium and high-risk driver groups to acquire the practical conclusions on traffic management, which can effectively improve the efficiency of driver safety risk management.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Monitoring and Arc Protection Based on Multispectral Detection in High Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As one of the most important equipment in power system, the safe and stable operation of high voltage switchgear directly affect the reliable operation of the system. At present, the relay protection system used by power sector can respond to extreme arcs immediately, but it can’t give reliable warnings of intermittent discharges in the early stage of arc development, which means it can only prevent power system from further damage, rather than avoid the arcing faults in the early time. Therefore, it is necessary to propose a method that can take into account early PD warning and reliable protection to reduce the damage of high voltage switchgear. In this paper, the activity of PD and arc in the ultraviolet, visible, and near-infrared spectra is explored by simultaneously measuring optical signals of partial discharge and arc discharge in the three bands using SiPM sensor. A reasonable PD warning threshold, as well as arc protection threshold is determined according to the experiment results.

articleTitle: Organize into Teams a Target Allotment a Problem according to the Threat Situation and the Weapon Effect
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Reasonable allocation of attack target in the combat team is a critical problem. Based on the consideration of aircraft performance and their team organizations, this thesis has introduced such a model, and validated via Hungary Algorithm, and the calculation result showed the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Stacked Autoencoder Method for the PAPR Reduction in VLC Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The visible light communication (VLC) system can provide data communication function as well as lighting. It is widely used in automated and sustainable smart farming for its energy efficiency, reliability, security without degrading the crops growth compared to radio frequency communication. A novel peak to average power ratio (PAPR) reduction method is applied based on stacked autoencoder network in VLC systems. The deep learning network is trained by a combined loss function. Simulation results reveal that the VLC system achieves a distinct PAPR reduction and shows an improved bit error ratio performance. The system can be easily implemented and controlled in the existing infrastructure. This research provides a basis for the feasibility of deep learning theory in the design of optical communication system.

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Speed Combined Prediction Model Based on ARIMA-GARCH and Elman
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to effectively improve the prediction accuracy, short-term wind speed combination prediction model based on ARIMA-GARCH and Elman is proposed. It adopts ARIMA model to linearly predict short-term wind speed and GARCH to improve the non-stationary series heteroscedasticity problems. What’s more, Elman neural network is used to nonlinearly predict short-term wind speed. Finally, the minimum weighting method of absolute error is used to determine the optimal linear weight of single model so as to realize short-term wind speed prediction. Case analysis shows that, compared with other prediction models, the combination model not only has significantly improved short-term wind speed prediction accuracy, but provides a certain reference to short-term wind speed prediction in relevant fields.

articleTitle: The Study of Community Evolution Classification Method Based on Similarity and Difference
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The analysis of community evolution in dynamic network is one of the current research hotspots, which plays an important role in public opinion control, network marketing, personalized recommendation service and so on. This paper proposes a nonparametric core node detection algorithm based on the evaluation index of node importance, which is used to find the core nodes in the community to form the core node set, and to judge the difference of community based on the core node set. Based on this, a classification model of community evolution based on similarities and differences is proposed. This model determines the evolution relationship and divides the evolution type from the two aspects of similarities and differences. Comparing the proposed classification model with GED and SGCI in HEP-TH and Polish political blogosphere data sets, the experimental results show that the proposed classification model is better than GED and SGCI classification model on the whole. Especially in the detection of forming and dissolving events, it can be sensitive to small communities, and can detect a variety of evolution types of small communities.

articleTitle: Content-aware Upsampling for Single Image Super-resolution
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Super-resolution reconstruction has recently become a hotspot in digital image processing. It has been widely used in medical imaging, video surveillance security, high-definition television terminals, and other fields. In this paper, our group propose an image super-resolution method based on content-aware upsampling. In our neural network, the convolution kernel does not share parameters across the entire feature map, but the network generates specific convolution kernels at each pixel according to the content of the feature map. We use residual dense module as the backbone network. The following data shows that our method has more potential on training and testing datasets and the reconstructed image is more clearer than the sub-pixel convolution layer method.

articleTitle: New Algorithm Design of Micro-vibration isolation Platform’s Robust Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Because of the piezoelectric micro-vibration isolation platform’s and the actuators’ perturbation, the 6-DOF micro-vibration isolation platform does not be considered as linear system, and which needs robust controllers control the piezoelectric micro-vibration isolation platform. Through the method of state feedback, based on Riccati inequality, designed a new algorithm of robust controller which contends compromise factors’ affection to isolate the low frequency distribution, and those factors’ affection are replaced by all kinds of platform model’s parameters distribution. The simulation and experiment results show that the Algorithm is better than the simple robust controller.

articleTitle: Fast Parallel Bounding Volume Hierarchy Construction
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Our algorithm optimized the parallel structure and speeded up the parallel construction based on the locally-ordered clustering to build the bounding volume hierarchy (BVH). We use the bottom-up approach to build the BVH, merging nearest clusters and subnearest clusters in each iteration. Our algorithm was verified in CUDA and evaluated in GPU ray tracing scenarios. Compared with other methods, our method is more efficient in building rate and effectively generates a more balanced BVH under complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Flexible Workshop Scheduling System
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The quantum particle swarm algorithm with the characteristics of fast convergence and superior global optimization shows more suitable for solving the shop scheduling problems than other intelligent optimization algorithms. A hybrid multi-phase quantum particle swarm algorithm has been proposed on the basis of the quantum particle swarm optimization in this paper. A flexible workshop scheduling system is designed and implemented in which the superiority of the new algorithm has been verified.

Author Keywords: hybrid multi-phase quantum particle swarm algorithm

articleTitle: Evaluation of Higher Education Development Level in Jiangsu Province Based on Factors and Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous enhancement of China’s comprehensive strength, higher education has become an essential factor in promoting economic development. Through quantitative analysis and empirical research, this paper explores the status of higher education in 13 cities in Jiangsu Province from multiple perspectives. First of all, we use factor analysis to reduce the dimensions of many indicators, quantify the overall value of higher education levels in prefecture-level cities through factor scores, and obtain corresponding education level rankings. Nanjing’s higher education level ranked first. Then, we use the principal component factor scores obtained from the factor analysis and cluster analysis of 13 cities in Jiangsu Province to find out their classification characteristics to summarize the differences between the connections between cities and the regional distribution of education levels.

articleTitle: A Maglev Gap Measurement Method based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: During the gap measurement of maglev system, aiming at the problem that gap sensor is easily affected by temperature, flatness of detection surface, inconvenient installation and other factors, a method of maglev gap measurement based on machine vision is proposed. First, according to the scale space theory, find the relative coordinates of the floating gap in the original image. Then use Canny operator to detect the edge characteristics of the electromagnet and the maglev ball, and sample the edge points of the electromagnet and the maglev ball according to the relative coordinates of the maglev gap. Finally, calculate the floating gap based on the pixel distance between the edge points. Experiments show that under the embedded ARM platform, the speed and accuracy of gap measurement meet the requirements of maglev control.

articleTitle: Research on High Power Factor Control Strategy of Single-Phase Electroless Capacitor Variable Frequency Speed Regulation System
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the high power factor control strategy of single-phase electroless capacitor variable frequency speed control system. The power factor of 0.977 can be obtained through matlab/simulink simulation. The single-phase non-electrolytic capacitor frequency conversion speed regulation system uses small-capacity film capacitors instead of traditional large-capacity electrolytic capacitors. It has the advantages of high power density and high input power factor on the grid side.

Author Keywords: Single-phase electroless capacitor variable frequency speed regulation system power factor

articleTitle: Network-assisted vertical handover scheme in heterogeneous aeronautical network
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Leveraging the efficient control of Software Defined Networking (SDN), the heterogeneous aeronautical networks can achieve seamless vertical handovers for the switching aircraft. In this paper, we design the vertical handover scheme assisted by the network-side SDN controller, and analyze its evaluation metrics including the successful handover probability, average handover latency and user satisfaction. Then, we evaluate these metrics under different SDN controller deployments. Numerical results show that the successful handover probability is not affected by different controller deployment solutions, and generally, for the vertical handovers under the ground-based controller deployment, their average handover delays and user satisfactions are better than those under the satellite-based controller deployment.

articleTitle: An Obstacle Avoidance Method for Autonomous Vehicle in Straight Road Based on Expanded Circle
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm is proposed to avoid online obstacle in a straight road or in an unknown environment. The algorithm is built upon the concept of expanded circle, which can be used to calculate the required steering angle for the vehicle. And then a lateral controller is designed to maintain the desired steering angle. Moreover, to keep the same posture of the vehicle after the obstacle avoidance manipulation, a constraint of the terminal point pose is added. The algorithm is computationally efficient, and guarantees online obstacle avoidance. Its performance is validated by actual experiments on autonomous vehicles in a laboratory setting and the results show that the proposed algorithm is more efficient than DWA, and even better than real human drivers.

articleTitle: GPU-accelerated Calculation of Acoustic Echo Characteristics of Underwater Targets
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the echo characteristics of submerged targets at far field. Based on the thought of shooting and bouncing ray (SBR), which uses geometrical optics (GO) principle and physical optics (PO) integration in combination, we propose a more efficient GPU-accelerated prediction method based on multiresolution grid algorithm in the SBR to calculate the target strength (TS) of concave complex targets. According to the simulation and experiment results on rigid sphere, cylinder and submarine model, the accuracy of the proposed approach is proved. Furthermore, the GPU-based SBR is more than 750x faster than CPU via GPU parallel computing architecture. And the proposed GPU-accelerated multiresolution SBR improves runtime performance at least 2. 4x over GPU-based SBR.

articleTitle: Insurance Renewal Probability Model Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Combined with the realistic background of vehicle insurance in daily life, this paper establishes a set of insurance renewal probability calculation model based on deep learning algorithm, and USES deep learning algorithm to analyze the data of users to calculate the renewal probability of users, which provides an effective reference method for the calculation of vehicle insurance renewal probability. This article USES Python and SPSS to analyze the collected data. Then the Isolation forest algorithm was used to analyze outliers. After extracting the outliers, Pearson correlation coefficient was used to analyze the correlation between the features of the data set and the renewal of the vehicle. The logistic regression model is established, the accurate portrait of the customer is made, and the probability of the customer's renewal is solved. According to the main impact of its renewal, the corresponding preferential policies have been formulated. It provides a certain basis for the future auto insurance industry to improve the customer renewal rate.

articleTitle: Acquisition and processing of facial motion capture data
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Face capture technology is applied in the fields of film and television production, auxiliary teaching, visual communication and human-computer interaction. This paper introduces the Vicon Cara face capture system, the collection method of face motion capture data and the method of sound and image data processing. It mainly includes the introduction of the system hardware and software, the preliminary preparation of facial motion capture data collection, and the optimization and processing of the collected data. Finally, high quality data were collected at the early stage of the study to improve the efficiency of subsequent data processing and ensure the quality of data processing.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Parallel Computing Technology of Airborne Test Data
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the task requirements of a small fast-moving test vehicle with small space, short flight support interval and real-time task evaluation, at the same time, the future flight test is faced with many test parameters, wide distribution of test systems, and high real-time data requirements. To solve the rapid acquisition test evaluation data in a specific environment, we design distributed system, data analysis and fusion technology, embedded parallel computing and other technologies to realize the parallel computing and real-time processing on airborne data. The calculated data results are directly telemetry or recorded for real-time monitoring and rapid assessment of missions. The design meets the requirements of rapid real-time evaluation during the flight test and improves the flight test efficiency.

articleTitle: A Cosine-tangent Fruit Fly optimization Algorithm for business performance of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Business performance is an important index to evaluate the sustainable development of enterprises. In the fierce competitive environment, how to propose more effective methods to accurately predict business performance has become the most concerned issue for listed companies. In this study, a novel cosine-tangent is used to improve the problems of trapping into local extreme easily and non-negative smell concentration judgment value of original FOA and enhance the accuracy of the prediction. It shows that the prediction accuracy and the convergence speed of the prediction model constructed by back propagation neural network are improved by CTFOA. It means CTFOA can be applied effectively in predicting business performance of Chinese listed companies and the optimization ability of CTFOA is better than original FOA.

articleTitle: Correlation Simulation Study of 71°C Method Formula and Arrhenius Formula
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to obtain the influence of each parameter value on the life prediction result in the 71°C test method, the correlation between the 71°C test method Equation and the Arrhenius Equation was studied by means of simulation. The research results show that the theoretical value of activation energy corresponding to the parameter r=2.7 is much lower than the activation energy of the energetic material actually used by the pyrotechnic products; the life extrapolation result of the 71°C test method Equation in the 71°C test method standard Compared with the Arrhenius Equation is very conservative; under the premise of not changing the failure mechanism, the acceleration coefficient obtained by performing the accelerated test in the high temperature region is more conservative and more reliable than the low temperature region.

articleTitle: Simulation Calculation Of Cl-20 Explosive Shock Initiation Reliability
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to obtain the reliability of CL-20 explosives shock initiation by small flying fins, a fluid-solid coupling algorithm was used to calculate the process of highspeed flyer impacting CL-20 explosives. A critical initiation threshold and parameters for CL-20 explosives is obtained based on James initiation criterion. The Weibull distribution is used to expand the critical shock initiation threshold curve of CL-20 explosives, and the CL-20 explosive initiation probability distribution map is established. The firing reliability of micro explosive train with similar structures is predicted and the result is certificated by experimental.

articleTitle: A Big Data Analysis Based System for the Comprehensive Evaluation of the Cultivation Quality of the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Skills among Chinese College Students
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The big data analysis based model for tracking the cultivation quality of college students’ innovation and entrepreneurship skills relies on the matching and synergy between elements such as diversified participants, funding, technology and network design, and institutional systems to achieve its swift and efficient operation. The creation and integration of these elements would be the future focus of this project. Through diversified data collection from existing systems and other databases, we employ the indigenously developed data scheduling system (DataX) to carry out centralized scheduling of data extraction, thereby building a big data analysis based system for the comprehensive evaluation of the cultivation quality of innovation and entrepreneurship skills.

Author Keywords: innovation and entrepreneurship skills among college students

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Path Planning Based on Transit Point
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The general path planning algorithm can only solve the shortest path or the lowest cost path problem, and can not play a very good role in path planning with throttling transfer points. In order to deal with the problem of road traffic flow or material flow path planning in the transportation process, this paper constructs the joint transportation network structure model based on the transfer point and the genetic algorithm, which can solve the problem of road traffic flow or material flow path planning in the transportation process. The model includes two sets of transfer point and connecting arc segment. The throttling information contained in the transfer point of the model can well constrain the flow problem in the path planning. The joint transportation network structure based on the transfer point is planned by genetic algorithm. In this paper, nine transport particles with flow are used for planning, and the results show that the method is simple and effective.

articleTitle: Wireless Optical Communication for Aircraft Passenger Cabin
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, using the lighting system in the aircraft passenger cabin as light sources, the feasibility of applying the optical wireless communication system to the cabin is studied. Research contents includes: system construction, system model, links and channels, coding and modulation. On this basis, four kinds of case simulation experiments are conducted by using the cabin model. Experimental results are proved that the optical wireless communication system has excellent receiving power, low path loss, high channel gain. The power of the light sources in the cabin can conform to the requirements of the system to the power of the light source. The scheme of this system can be invoked as a reference for the aircraft manufacturers to develop the cabin communication equipment.

articleTitle: An End-to-end Obstacle Avoidance Algorithm for Autonomous Vehicles Based on Global Path Constraint
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, local obstacle avoidance algorithm for autonomous vehicles has matured significantly. Existing methods can be divided into two stages: path planning and motion planning, which have the disadvantage of high computational complexity and falling into local optimum easily. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end obstacle avoidance method based on obstacle location information and global path. Firstly, a mathematical model is constructed to transform the obstacle information into local error. Secondly, the states of the vehicle at several subsequent moments are estimated. Finally, the PD controller is utilized to control the vehicle, which considers the local error and the global attitude error. The result of our method is compared with standard DWA algorithm and the action of real human drivers regarding the path smoothness, lateral acceleration and the pose after the obstacle avoidance. The experimental result shows the advantage of our method. There is no need to select the goal point of each period with the constraint of the expected pose. We can achieve the goal with a smooth trajectory and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Key Technologies of Multi-active data synchronization for Dispatch and Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the “physical distribution and logical integration” architecture of new generation power grid dispatching and control system, with requirements of the crossterminal display, cross-center transparent access and multicenter business collaboration, it is necessary to develop a technical framework of data synchronization based on global analysis and decision. Through unified data synchronization, distributed transactions and data recovery and other functions to achieve multi-center data consistency, improve the centralized management of data in the control system. Finally, through the test and live demonstration, data synchronization function of multi-center was verified.

articleTitle: The Specific Implementation of a Programmable Arbitrary Digital Signal Generator
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the principle of DDS signal synthesis, a scheme of signal generator based on Timer and D/A converter is introduced. The design principle, structure and implementation of arbitrary signal generator based on MCU platform are introduced in detail, and the specific waveform generation algorithm of rectangular wave, sine wave, triangle wave, sawtooth wave and noise signal is given. The resource constraints and the characteristics of the waveform generated by the hardware platform are analyzed. The test results verify the feasibility and rationality of the design. The implementation method of the signal generator mentioned in this paper can be applied to many kinds of microcontroller platforms, the waveform is arbitrary and programmable, and the structure is simple, so it can be flexibly integrated into the embedded system.

articleTitle: Design of Vibrating Navigation Bracelet Based on BLE 4.0
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A vibrating navigation bracelet is designed with the use of BLE 4.0, combining WeChat mini program with hardware. The bracelet uses an RF integrated chip CC2650 to control two vibration motors, receives location coordinates data from a GPS/BD module and stores coordinates of turning points on the route which are sent by mini program. The bracelet processes real-time coordinates data with Vector Cross Product algorithm, calculates the direction according to the stored route, then sends turning signal when it comes close to a turning point, through two vibration motors which touch both inner and outer sides of human wrist. At the end of the paper, the feasibility of the system is verified through a practical test.

articleTitle: An Improved VPI Current Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to achieve high-precision compensation of LCL-type APF(active power filter) harmonic current error signals, this paper proposes a VPI (vector proportional integral)current control strategy based on the $\alpha\beta$ stationary coordinate system. Compared with the traditional PR (Proportion Resonant) current control strategy, the VPI current control strategy based on the $\alpha\beta$ stationary coordinate system has the characteristics of phase advance, which can compensate the lagging phase of the LCL interface filter, ensuring that the closed-loop frequency response of the current control achieves an ideal 0° phase response at the resonance frequency, which improves the APF current closed-loop control stability and current control accuracy. By comparing the open-loop amplitude-frequency characteristics and closed-loop frequency response characteristics of the PR and VPI current control strategies in the $\alpha\beta$ stationary coordinate system, the excellent characteristics of the VPI current control strategy based on the $\alpha\beta$ stationary coordinate system are demonstrated. The experimental results verify the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Characteristic of the YH25 Wave Compensator
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To improve the control performance of the YH25 wave compensator, for better application in industrial production, the force servo-hydraulic control system (FSHCS) of the YH25 wave compensator was designed. The control scheme of the FSHCS was formulated, and the mathematical model from each link was established in the FSHCS. Compound control theory was applied to the model of the FSHCS, and the mathematical model of the FSHCS was derived. Pole allocation was used in the FSHCS. The state feedback matrix was determined. On the basis of that, the optimization and simulation were carried to the system. The oil temperature, viscosity and pressure of the FSHCS of the YH25 wave compensator were tested, and the experiment carried products similar to working conditions was conducted. The results showed that the temperature of hydraulic oil had a range from 30 to 36 degrees. The viscosity range had a range from 17 to 19 cst and the system pressure varied from 20 to 24 MPa in the FSHCS of the YH25 wave compensator. The results met design requirements and had affirmed that the hydraulic system was reasonable and feasible. The results of the experiment carried products can meet the requirements of products for diving assembly firms, and can compensate alternating load of wire rope lifted heavy objects.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Computer Network Based on Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The rapid development of network information technology has promoted the overall progress of society and greatly improved people's living standards. Under the background of the rapid development of network technology, people's demand is also increasing. It is no longer effective to meet people's demand just to speed up and increase the transmission speed and capacity of information. As far as artificial intelligence technology is concerned, it is one of the most promising technologies in the field of computer network development. It is not only applied officially, but also most citizens are gradually applying artificial intelligence technology to their lives, which has greatly promoted the development of computer network technology. Based on the demand for intelligent development of computer network technology in the era of big data, the author analyzes the basic characteristics of big data and the advantages of artificial intelligence application, focusing on the specific application of artificial intelligence in computer network technology in the era of big data.

articleTitle: Stochastic P-Bifurcation of Bistable van der Pol System under Fractional Gaussian Noise: Theory and Experiment
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, the stochastic P-bifurcation problem of bistable van der Pol systems under fractional Gaussian noise (fGn) is discussed. Using the random average method to predict the stochastic dynamic behavior of the system under fGn and to obtain the stable probability density function of the response amplitude of the system, and then using the singularity theory to obtain the critical condition of stochastic P-bifurcation of the system. The results show that the H index in the fGn can induce the stochastic P-bifurcation in system, and the larger the H index is, the larger the stable probability density distribution becoming the bimodal region is. It indicates that the noise intensity required for the stochastic P-bifurcation becomes larger, which is beneficial to improve the stability of the equilibrium point of the system. At the same time, the system under the numerical simulation and circuit experiment has the same results as the theoretical analysis, which further insures the correctness of the research results.

articleTitle: Design in Unified Coding Architecture for Information and Communication Assets Life Cycle Management
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to strengthen the interconnection of the information and communication assets of power grid, this paper assigns the unique identity code for the information and communication assets. The unified coding architecture solves the problem that the front-end project material information is difficult to trace and share with the back-end equipment assets. It helps to realize the information sharing and traceability of physical assets in the whole life cycle of planning, procurement, operation and maintenance, and decommissioning, which can also improve the management level of the power grid assets.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Transmitter in Video Transmission System Based on COFDM
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the view of the development and application of the COFDM technology and software radio technology, the wireless video transmission system hardware platform is built by Zedboard and AD9361 wireless transceiver. The whole baseband processing system is designed under IEEE.802.11a physical layer protocol. The signal processing of transmitting baseband is realized and the simulation test is carried out.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of High-altitude on Performance of an Opposed-Piston Gasoline Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The engine performance test was carried out on the high-performance test bench of opposed-piston engine of UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) from 0m to 7000m altitudes. The influence of altitudes on power, torque, fuel consumption, and heat balance (cylinder surface temperature and heat flow distribution) of the engine were analyzed. The results showed that power and torque of the engine gradually decrease with the altitudes increasing. The power and torque were reduced by about 11.25% and 12.5% respectively, and the fuel consumption rate increased by 14.4% and 2.8% respectively at low-speed and high-speed with altitude rises 1000m. At the altitude of 0-3000m, the temperature and the surface temperature of the cylinder surface decreased by 18.7 and 7.9 degrees respectively with altitude of sea level per 1000m. At the altitude of 3000m-7000m, the temperature and the surface temperature of the cylinder surface decreased by 31.9 and 21.2. The outlet temperature of cooling water increased first and then decreased with altitudes increasing, and the extent of variation at high-speeds was greater than that at low-speeds. The effective thermal efficiency of the engine is less than 5%, while the percentage of lost heat is over 30% under 3000rpm speed at the altitude of 6000m.

articleTitle: Study on Stocks Based on Big Data Methods and Computer Programs
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Recently big data is a hot topic in many fields. Here we use distributed algorithms to treat big data in Chinese stock market. First the two stock indexes (Shanghai Composite and Shenzhen Composite indexes) from 1990-2019 are collected. Then the data are divided to several subsets and are analyzed separately via computer programs. Finally the results for every subset are combined due to distributed algorithms theory. In addition to big data scheme, we adopt stochastic processes theory and moment equations methods.

Author Keywords: vy processes, Chinese stock index, Moment estimations

articleTitle: Reseach On Numerical Simulation Overload Response Of Semiconductor Bridge Detonators In Multi-Layer Steel Target Penetration Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to study mechanical overload characteristics semiconductor bridge detonators under the penetration environment of the multi-layer steel target, the simulation model of the penetration process of the multi-layer steel target in different states was established by use of LSDYNA. The relationship between the length of the shell, the diameter of the shell, the length of the column and the target plate arrangement order, the target plate spacing, the penetration angle were investigated. The results show that When the thick target is in the middle of two thin targets, the axial load of the detonator is small; when the target spacing is 0∼1 times projectile body, with the target spacing increases the axial load of detonator increases; When the penetration angle is between 0° and 20°, as the angle of penetration increasing the detonator is less overloaded.

articleTitle: The First Exploration on the Application of Big Data and Corpus Analysis in the Study of Cultural Genes of Austronesian
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: There is a population of about 400 million in Austronesian languages with a total of more than 1200 kinds of language. This thesis provides some preliminary discussion ideas on the cultural universities of Austronesian and linguistic and cultural transfer rules analyzed by corpus big data under the perspective of the cultural genes of Austronesian, and plays a certain role in the implementation of the "One Belt and One Road" strategy and the promotion of the study on Austronesian culture.

articleTitle: Application of sensor technology in automatic confluence device of product conveying line
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: On the production line, in order to combine the products from different branches, it is equipped with automatic confluence device. The automatic confluence device is mainly composed of transverse conveyor, longitudinal conveyor and throwing roller. The transmissive sensor and reflective sensor are arranged on the device. The base position and vertical distance of the transmissive sensor are calculated. And the positioning principle of reflective sensor is set. The automatic confluence device is used for conveying cigarette cases on the automatic sorting system of the cigarette production line. This equipment has simple structure, less investment and high operation reliability, which can effectively realize automatic confluence conveying of products.

articleTitle: The Research of Code-detector of the Infrared Remote Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the improvement of people's life quality, the variety of home appliances of the more and more rich, so the infrared remote control as an important component of the control of household appliances, role is extremely important.
