The infrared remote control is currently on the market can only simple control electric equipment, although a button corresponds to a function, but not know what each key corresponding coding, this paper introduces the design of the detection of infrared remote control decoder can be received code displayed, effectively solve the above defects, can clear know each key corresponding coding. Infrared remote control system first of all electrical appliances of infrared remote control signal identification and storage, and then effectively reduction in use process, select, and then go to a designated infrared remote control device to work.

articleTitle: Computer Numerical Simulation Analysis on Construction Optimization of Double-side Wall Pit Method in Large-section Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the schedule and reduce the risk during the construction procedure of large-section subway station tunnel, the numerical simulation software FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> is used to carry out the optimization simulation analyses in this paper. The optimization analyses focus on the construction procedure and temporary vertical support of double-side wall guide pit. Through the comparison and analysis of different working conditions, the results show that the surrounding rock stress and displacement are relatively small after the excavation of the optimized double-side wall guide pit method, and the vertical temporary support has limited effect on controlling the surrounding rock stress and displacement.

articleTitle: Design of Environmental Monitoring System in Chicken House Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In view of the current low level of automation Chinese chicken breeding, management, technological backwardness of the status quo, but also for the realization of the chicken coop wireless monitoring environment, we design a chicken coop wireless monitoring system based on wireless sensor networks. System consists of terminal equipment, routing equipment, coordination of equipment and PC four parts, using CC2530 chip as the processor, in order to achieve the planned ZigBee protocol wireless data transmission. The system not only realizes the chicken coop temperature, humidity, concentration of harmful gases (H2S, NH3) and other environmental parameters in real-time collection and monitoring, but also on the chicken coop on the environment by setting parameters to achieve the terminal device settings automatic transmission control parameters and control commands via manual control. The experiments show that the system is simple, reliable, real-time high scalability, can effectively monitor the coop environmental parameters.

articleTitle: Modeling of pressure-flow in the flow facility based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, considering the valve opening and pump frequency, the pressure-flow model in the pipeline of the flow facility is established based on support vector machine (SVM), and the instantaneous flow value can be calculated by established SVM model using pressure in the pipeline measured by pressure sensors. Through the experimental test on the flow facility, the training samples and test samples are obtained to train and test the established SVM model. At the same time, in order to compare the calculation result of SVM model, a BP neural network model is established as a comparison. By comparing the SVM model with BP model, it is found that the calculation results of the SVM model is closer to the real value than calculation results of BP model, and the SVM model has good calculation ability and can accurately obtain the instantaneous flow value through the measured pressure in the pipeline.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Improved APRIORI Algorithm Based on Hash Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Apriori Algorithm is the most Classic Association Rule Mining Algorithm, which has unique advantages, but it also has some disadvantages such as high overhead. This paper first describes Apriori Algorithm, points out its shortcomings, introduces related concepts, and then proposes a method based on Hash technology and compressed combination item set technology to improve APRIORI algorithm. This paper introduces the basic idea and the concrete process of the improvement in detail, analyzes the efficiency of the improved algorithm by the experiment, and advances the application of the improved algorithm in the library personalized service.

articleTitle: A Parallel Algorithm Based on OpenMP for Human Brain Model of Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complex and variable bio-electromagnetic computing, large amount of calculation, and insufficient calculation accuracy to meet the actual clinical needs, a parallel algorithm based on OpenMP was introduced. A multi-threaded operation of the electromagnetic computing model was realized by using a mixed programming method. The parallel method work at a single-computer with multi-core is performed on the electromagnetic calculation process of the human brain model stimulated by the transcranial magnetic stimulation coil, which improves the calculation efficiency of the model, so that the electromagnetic calculation of the brain model with higher accuracy can be satisfied.

articleTitle: A Joint Estimation Algorithm for Symbol Timing Offset and Carrier Frequency Offset of OFDM Signals Based on Strongly Related Sequences
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of traditional symbols and carrier synchronization methods for OFDM signals, a joint estimation algorithm of symbol timing offset and carrier frequency offset based on strong correlation training sequence is proposed. First, a joint synchronization model of the receiver symbol and carrier of the OFDM signal is given, and the effects of symbol timing deviation and carrier frequency deviation are analyzed theoretically. Secondly, a training sequence composed of two repeated OFDM symbols with conjugate symmetry is constructed in which a random sequence weighting factor is introduced to the OFDM training symbols, and a time-frequency joint synchronization algorithm using the training sequence is given. Finally, the performance of symbol timing offset estimation and carrier frequency offset estimation in the proposed method are simulated and analyzed under different signal-to-noise ratios. Simulation results show that the symbol timing offset estimation has sharper timing synchronization peaks, is not affected by the signal-to-noise ratio, and the mean square error of the frequency offset estimation is low, which further improves the system performance.

articleTitle: A Rapid Service Mulitiplex Method for Multimedia Broadcasting based on Queuing Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For the ability of broadcasting the large amount of data, China Mobile Multimedia Broadcasting (CMMB) has become an important complement technology of mobile service. CMMB broadcasting the data through the data cache, multiplexing, scrambling, which are leading more data-broadcasting delay. It makes the real-time stock, ticketing, road business cannot be carried out. In this paper, we analyze the CMMB data-broadcasting delay distribution, which makes derivation of the multiplexing takes the most delay of the broadcasting. And the current methods to reduce multiplexing delay are low-efficiency, long- queuing time and poor algorithm-realization, this article puts forward a rapid service multiplexing method for multimedia broadcasting based on queuing theory, which improve the control and schedule in the multiplex with the queue model to reduce the multiplexing delay. The simulation and application confirm the method proposed by the paper can be reduced to the multiplexing delay of 3 seconds.

articleTitle: Error Processing Of Quartz Resonator In Humidity Measurement Based On Bp Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, a quartz resonator used in Quartz crystal microbalance (QCM) is used as the humidity sensitive element to directly measure the relative humidity, and a model of frequency-relative humidity(F-RH) based on BP neural network is established to eliminate the hysteresis and repeatability errors. The model is trained and tested by the data samples obtained from the humidity measurement experiment. The frequency-relative humidity(F-RH) model based on BP neural network can be used to calculate the relative humidity in the measured environment. This method can eliminate the hysteresis and repeatability errors of the quartz resonator in a certain extent, and make the humidity measurement result of the quartz resonator more accurate.

articleTitle: Defect Detection of Sheet Metal Based on Heat Wave Method
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Infrared thermal wave imaging is a new type of non-destructive testing technology. This article introduces the basic theoretical principles of non-destructive testing of infrared thermal wave imaging, and establishes an infrared thermal wave image acquisition system for metal plates. For the detection of internal defects in sheet metal, infrared heat wave technology is used. Aiming at the characteristic of serious background noise interference of infrared heat wave image, a method of homomorphic filtering enhancement processing for infrared heat wave image was studied. Finally, OTSU, KSW entropy and particle swarm algorithm are used to perform threshold segmentation on the enhanced image to effectively extract the internal defects of the target and lay a good foundation for the quantitative analysis of the defect area and diameter of subsequent target areas.

articleTitle: Density Reconstruction Algorithm In Ultrasound Computed Tomography Using Full Waveform Inversion With Source Encoding
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This work proposed an algorithm to reconstruct the density distribution of the object in ultrasound computed tomography (UCT) imaging modality. The proposed algorithm combined the full waveform inversion method and source encoding technique to calculate the gradient of the density and estimate the density distribution directly, which have not been achieved in current literature. In the work, a numerical solution of a density distribution is obtained by solving a penalized optimization problem. Meanwhile, it used the full waveform inversion method to consider the high-order acoustic diffraction effects and the source encoding technique to significantly alleviate computational burden. Computer simulation was conducted to demonstrate the proposed method. The results suggested that the proposed method could reconstruct the density distribution directly with only UCT imaging modality.

articleTitle: Simulation And Optimal Design Of Planar Coil For Magnetic Recoil Generator
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the productivity and efficiency of the magnetic recoil generation device, this paper optimizes the coil part of the device and replaces the traditional winding coil with the plane coil. Through the Maxwell electromagnetic simulation software, the single-layer plane coil and the multi-layer plane coil are simulated and analyzed respectively, and the rule of the influence of the wire spacing of the single-layer plane coil and the series parallel mode of the double-layer plane coil on the production capacity is obtained. The results show that: when the duty cycle of plane coil is 1:2, the productivity efficiency is the highest; when plane coil is connected in series, the induced current does not change, and the induced electromotive force is linear superposition; when plane coil is connected in parallel, the induced electromotive force does not change, and the induced current is linear superposition; the productivity of plane coil is different under different heights, and the plane coil at the middle height has the highest induced electromotive force. These conclusions can provide the basis for the optimal design of plane coil and the selection of connection mode of plane coil.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Vivaldi Antenna Array Design
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Wide bandwidth and wide scan angle antenna size is large, but the phased array has a limitation on the size of the antenna unit. In order to solve the problem, the article uses a Vivaldi antenna with a toe structure as the antenna unit. By using a director, the wideband effect is achieved, meanwhile the voltage standing wave ratio in the 8.6GHz-12.4GHz band is less than 1.5, and the 3dB beamwidth in the range of 9GHz to 11GHz is extended to ± 70 °. While in this case, the antenna size is only 36mm $\times$ 15mm $\times$ 0.762mm. A 16 $\times$ 1 array of such unit achieves a wide scanning pattern greater than ± 40 °, the mutual coupling of the array elements less than -10dB. This miniaturized array antenna shows good working characteristics in the range of 9GHz to 11GHz.

articleTitle: An Autonomous Service Mobile Robot for Indoor Environments
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an autonomous indoor service robot system framework integrated with multi-sensors to implement the service robotic functions. Both the voice recognition and real-time object detection capabilities are incorporated in this system. Firstly, a novel mapping strategy is proposed to build a hybrid grid-topological-semantic map which is used for voice-control-based navigation for robots. Secondly, in order to reduce the power consumption of mobile robot object detection, a low-power parallel acceleration method using neural network accelerator sticks is proposed. And the power consumption is reduced by 15 times with approximately the same frame rate compared with laptop GPU GTX 960M. Moreover, the YOLO model used in this system is about 10 times faster than two-stage methods. In addition, the experiment result demonstrates that the proposed mapping strategy can be well combined with the voice recognition system to achieve voice-controlled navigation. The structure of the robot system we designed in this paper can be widely applied to indoor service robots.

articleTitle: Research on Control Algorithm for Laser Guided AGV Based on Proximal Policy
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Path tracking control is the key to ensure that the laser guided automated guided vehicles (LGAGVs) can deliver the goods to the designated place quickly and safely. However, it is very difficult to build accurate AVG dynamic model because of the variety of LGAGV dynamic types. In addition, a lot of manual test work is needed in traditional path tracking control, which makes the design of LGAGV path tracking challengeable. In this paper, the deep reinforcement learning (RL) is used to realize the design of LGAGV path tracking controller. Firstly, according to its characteristics, LGAGV path tracking problem is described as a Markov decision process (MDP) with continuous state and continuous action under the unknown transition probability. Then, a reliable control policy was learnt by LGAGV through the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) without any additionally exploring the possibilities. The simulation results show that the distance error and the stability of the control motor are better than the traditional model free algorithmic control when the angle error is fitting.

articleTitle: A Human Skeleton Data Optimization Algorithm For Multi-Kinect
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As a motion capture device, Kinect can extract human skeleton data (three dimensional positions of body joints) through depth information, which has been increasingly applied in many fields such as action recognition, medical diagnosis and rehabilitation evaluation. But when collecting human skeleton data with a single Kinect, the detection range is limited and stale data exceptions or data missing might occur due to the influence of human body occlusion and environment. These invalid data will directly affect the accuracy of relevant calculation results and hinder the application of Kinect. To solve the above problems, we propose a data acquisition scheme based on multi-Kinect and an optimization algorithm for human skeleton data. First, we use the method based spatial region constraints and K-means clustering to remove the outliers in the human skeleton data collected by each Kinect. Then we convert the data from different perspectives into the same coordinate system and perform adaptive weighted fusion. We finally obtain a stable and valid data sequence, facilitating its application greatly. We design relevant experiments to compare the optimized data with the original data and the results verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Exploring The Effects Of local Environment On Population Distribution: Using Imagery Segmentation Technology And Street View
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The relationships between local environment and the activity and mobility of urban population is one of the classic theoretical issues in urban studies. Yet one of major limitation of evaluating the local environment is that the current measurements are not precise enough and hard to quantify. This article applies the imagery segmentation technology and street view to measure the visual quality of local environment, which can effectively supplement the deficiencies of traditional variables. Then the spatial relationships between local environment and population distribution measured by Tencent locational big data are explored using spatial statistical regression models including spatial error model and spatial lag model. The results show that the local environment have significant effects on dynamics of urban population. The quantitative relationships between local environment and population distribution in this article can provide implications and suggestions for urban planning and street design.

articleTitle: Intelligent business cloud service platform based on SpringBoot framework
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This article is based on the SpringBoot platform, which displays real-time news and information on various economies and policies in countries and regions along the "Belt and Road", and solves the problem of difficult data processing of the "Belt and Road" complex data. In order to improve the readability of the data, this platform analyzes the cluttered data to generate statistical charts, and obtains key information in real time and intuitively. This system uses Spring, SpringBoot, Mybatis as the background framework scheme, and the front end uses the more popular Vue with strong performance and good performance. Finally, the intelligent cloud service platform system based on B / S architecture is designed, which has practical application value.

articleTitle: A Memory Management Strategy Based on Task Requirement for In-Memory Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For in memory computing framework, the memory allocation category cannot adjust the proportion of memory according to different data processing scenarios, and there are limitations in terms of memory usage and performance. In order to solve the issue, we analyzes the spark memory model, defines the concepts of available memory amount, job execution time, data inclination, execution area demand, execution area allocation amount, execution area overflow amount, task fairness, task demand degree, etc., presents the theoretical analysis, proposes the memory optimization algorithm based on the execution area on demand allocation, and determines the memory allocation amount according to the size of task input data. On the basis of slightly modifying spark source code, the memory allocation of storage area minimization and execution area for tasks is optimized to reduce cache loss and memory overflow and improve task execution efficiency.

articleTitle: ANFIS BASED Intelligent Energy Management and optimization of CHPB System with Multiobjective function
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A combined system of heating, power and biogas (CHPB) system has been developed and tested in a single building in MinQin County, Gansu Province, China. The CHPB system shows favorable performances of heating in most winter days. However, when bad weather lasts over two days, the system would not meet the heating. Therefore, for the sake of reduce the operation cost and the environmental impact of the CHPB system considering its preoperational variable is the future availability of renewable energy, intelligent energy management of the CHPB system is proposed in this paper. The factors, such as the ambient temperature, humidity, power availability, and wind speed, are predicted by adaptive Neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and then are combined with the instantaneous value of the backup batteries state of charge (SOC) and a gas tank level to make a decision whether to use the gas or electricity stored in the backup batteries to satisfy the user demand by fuzzy system. The cost saving of the proposed multiobjective intelligent energy management (MIEM) approach compared to operation based on opportunity was equal to 9.24% compared to 12.9% for the next day as a result of the intelligent switch scheduling, and lS.49 % compared to 26.5 for CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission.

articleTitle: Implementation of Least Squares Algorithm Based on Dynamic Threshold in Beidou Satellite Positioning
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, China’s Beidou Navigation Satellite System (BDS) has been successfully applied in all walks of life, entering a period of rapid development. The least squares algorithm is often used to solve problems in the application of BDS, while the quaternary nonlinear equation set is used for solving the positioning and timing issues. The application of least square algorithm in the PVT solution of Beidou satellite navigation is to solve a set of quaternion nonlinear equations. The solution of the least squares is an iterative process, but if the convergence threshold is too small in the iterative process, it may lead to iteration without convergence. In order to improve the failure of convergence caused by too small convergence threshold in the original algorithm, a least squares algorithm based on dynamic threshold was proposed in this paper. The proposed algorithm could continue iteration until convergence by increasing the system’s dynamic threshold. At the same time, the proposed algorithm could also change the satellite combination in time, so as to conduct the positioning and calculation again over the threshold value that increases to a fixed value but fails to converge. And the simulation results show that if the threshold is set too small, it can converge well. As a result, the algorithm not only effectively prevents the program failure in Beidou satellite positioning caused by the convergence failure of algorithm iteration, but also greatly improves the stability and reliability of the system program operation.

articleTitle: Study on the Quality of life of the Internet’s active population in China from the perspective of big data
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this study, the data of quality of life (QOL) of Internet’s active population in six provinces and two big cities of China was collected by big data, using the World Health organization Quality of Life Questionnaire (WHOQOL-BREF).On the basis of the data, the relationship of quality of life (QOL) and its influencing factors of this kind of person was set up and all the process was analyzed using Partial Least Squares (PLS) approach via Smart PLS software 3.0. The results show that traditional factors such as physiological factors, psychological factors, and environmental factors have a positive relationship on the quality of life (QOL) of the Internet’s active population but social relationships do not since the demand and dependence of people on traditional social network is weakening under the background of big data era.

articleTitle: Coordinate Cache Management for Performance Improvement in Spark
publicationTitle: 2020 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In big data parallel computing framework, I/O throughput dominates the performance, especially for data intensive workloads. As an outstanding solution of parallel computation, Spark cache Resilient Distribution Datasets (RDDs) in different nodes to speed up the process of computation. However, Spark does not have a good strategy to select reasonable RDDs to cache their partitions in limited memory. This paper proposed a novel cache management strategy, which comprised of Selection Algorithm and Cluster Global Cleanup algorithm (CSC). Selection Algorithm caching RDD’s partitions in memory automatically order by the number of use for RDDs to speeds up data intensive computations. Nevertheless, when lots of new RDDs are chosen to cache in memory while limited memory has been out of mana, the system will adopt the Least Recently Used (LRU) replacement algorithm. LRU is not only a cleaner of worker but also a trigger of CSC. According to “full or nothing” property of parallel computation, CSC recycling wasted memory space of other workers. Experiment results show that Spark with our selection algorithm speeds up the data intensive workloads and CSC Contribute to the improvement of memory utilization.
